title: Plants and seeds
examples: What are the different parts of a plant?
What do plants need to grow big and strong?
Can you show me the life cycle of a plant?

explain.say: Look at the plant. A plant has parts. They are roots, a stem, leaves and a flower.
Look at the seed as it starts to grow. Tap a part, and I will tell you its name.
The roots grow down into the soil. They take in water. The stem holds the plant up.
The leaves use sunlight to make food for the plant. The flowers help the plant make seeds.

items: Leaves use sunlight to make food

explain.say: A seed holds a tiny new plant inside. It needs water and warmth to start growing.

draw.text: A seed needs water and warmth

explain.say: First the seed grows a tiny root down. Then a little shoot grows up.
You can plant a sunflower seed in a pot of soil. Water it and keep it warm. When the leaves come up, it needs light.

draw.text: A growing plant needs water and light

explain.say: A growing plant needs water, light and air. With too little water, its leaves droop.

faq.q: What do plants use sunshine for?
faq.a: Plants use sunshine to make their own food. This process is very important for them to live.
asks: Does sunshine help plants make food?

faq.q: Are roots the same as the stem?
faq.a: No, the roots stay underground to drink water. The stem is the part that usually stands up above the ground.
asks: What is the difference between roots and stems?

faq.q: What happens after a plant makes seeds?
faq.a: The seeds can fall off and wait for good soil. Then, they can start the whole growing process again.
asks: Can seeds grow into new plants?
What is the next step after seeds?

faq.q: Do plants need air to grow?
faq.a: Yes, plants need air, just like we do. They take in air through their leaves to help them breathe.

faq.q: Can a plant grow without water?
faq.a: No, plants cannot survive for long without water. Water helps the roots drink up everything they need.
asks: What is the most important thing for plants?
Will a plant die without rain?

facts: Plants have roots that anchor them in the soil.
Leaves are important because they help the plant make food.
Seeds are the beginning of a new plant life.
Plants need water, light, air and warmth to grow. Most plants grow in soil.

quiz.say: Look at the plant. Tap the part that grows under the soil.
quiz.why: The roots grow down into the soil. They take in water.

wrong.0: Leaves grow above the soil, where they get sunlight.
wrong.2: The flower grows at the top of the stem.

quiz.say: Look at the seed. Tap what it needs to start growing.
quiz.why: A seed needs water and warmth to start growing.

wrong.1: A seed takes in plain water, so milk will not help it grow.
wrong.2: Stones are hard and dry, but a seed needs to be wet.

quiz.say: Look at the seed. Tap what grows out of it first.
quiz.why: A tiny root grows out first. Then a shoot grows up.

wrong.0: The flower comes much later, when the plant is big.
wrong.1: New seeds come at the end, from the flower.
